headings: WE ARE CREATIVE RESEARCHERS LOCATED IN SAN DIEGO

sources.text: Research Work by the Tezcan Group spans all areas of chemistry and utilizes a diverse array of tools ranging from molecular biology, chemical synthesis, polymer science, and computational chemistry to X-ray crystallography, electron microscopy, spectroscopy and advanced materials characterization techniques. We pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative environment in which our collective expertise allows us to identify and explore novel research avenues. Metalloprotein Design Nitrogenase Structure and Function Chemical Design of Functional Protein-Based Materials
